subject: Business Models
title: Luxury Marketplace Challenges
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Luxury Marketplace Challenges.

hook.text: The RealReal sells authenticated luxury goods online. Counterfeit scandals nearly destroyed it.

buildup.text: Luxury marketplaces face a unique trust problem: the cost of a single fake item is enormous.

discovery.text: Authentication must be perfect. One viral counterfeit story can wipe out years of trust-building.

twist.text: Luxury brands like Chanel refuse to participate. They view resale marketplaces as threats to exclusivity.

climax.text: Luxury marketplaces must fight counterfeits, hostile brands, and high return rates simultaneously.

punchline.text: One fake Chanel bag can destroy a luxury marketplace's reputation.

quiz.question: Why are luxury brands hostile to resale marketplaces?
options: They view resale as a threat to brand exclusivity
